title: On the EPA’s Radar: The Role of Financial Reports in Environmental Regulatory Oversight
sources_checked: SEC, EDGAR Log File Data Sets (official page, updated 2026-03-03; accessed 2026-11-18): first set 2003-01-01–2017-06-30; second set 2020-05-19–2025-06-30; 2017-07-01–2020-05-18 unavailable; second set lacks SEC IP ranges. https://www.sec.gov/data/edgar-log-file-data-set.html

Current local resource catalog output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json (generated 2026-10-27; 959 SAS datasets, 630 physical-file entries): SEC resources are raw/parsed filing archives; WRDSSEC entries include filings, item and link tables, not request logs. No local SEC EDGAR request-log table is cataloged.

Accepted prepared handoff, not a current-vintage raw-source reconstruction: output/executions/packages/jar-557644d8d842/work/Output/sample.dta (246,826 rows; date_monthly 2003-01-31–2017-06-30), case.dta (865; resolution_month 2003-01-31–2017-06-30), inspect.dta (5,257; Inpsection_Month 2003-01-31–2017-06-30), and rule.dta (49,433; Publication_Month 2003-01-31–2017-01-31). Hashes match task local_inputs.json; date-only reads, aggregate results only.

Accepted construction, source package: 3. Merge and clean data.sas:11-27 consumes EPAEdgar and SEC master-index-derived Uniquefile_form; lines 941-945 exports sample.dta. 5. Regression results.do:37-56 consumes sample.dta and calls corrtbl for Table 2B; Tables 3-8 use edgar and date_monthly.

Current local catalog candidates COMP.FUNDA, CRSP.MSEALL, CRSP.CCMXPF_LNKHIST and COMPSEG.WRDS_SEGMERGED were identified by name/path in the catalog; catalog metadata/one-row field presence is not a date-coverage claim and none supplies the missing EPA-specific SEC request logs.
changes: Recorded the requested extension per observation clock: firm-month, case, and inspection analyses from 2003-01–2017-06 to 2022-06; the rule-publication analysis from 2003-01–2017-01 to 2022-01.
No pooled data or model code was changed: the required post-2017 EPA EDGAR measure is not supported by the current compatible source. No scientific execute stage was launched.
limitations: The official SEC page documents no request-log records from 2017-07-01 through 2020-05-18. Its later set starts 2020-05-19 but explicitly excludes SEC IP ranges, so it cannot identify the EPA IP blocks used for the outcome. This blocks compatible added observations through the requested endpoint.

The current local resource catalog is a bounded inventory, not a filesystem-wide absence proof. It lists SEC filings resources and WRDSSEC filing/index/link products, but no request-log source; the job local_inputs.json contains the frozen 2003–2017 prepared handoff only. Other upstream author-prepared inputs were not re-invented or replaced.
Carry-forward: Table 2B is unexecuted because author-compatible corrtbl remains unresolved (work/tables_3_8.do:19; task.json prior_gaps).

Carry-forward: the predecessor reported non-positive semi-definite VCV adjustment warnings in 22 Tables 3-8 fits, 10 F-statistic fits, and 6 Figure 2-4 fits; its original estimator and Stata adjustment were retained in the predecessor run. Table 9B-9D reported no such warnings.
